documents.title: Circular 8 (2024-2025) Lineamientos y guías para la integración y uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en los proyectos académicos y de investigación del Recinto de Río Piedras
documents.quality_note: Campus guidelines for AI in academic and research projects. Spanish text.

notes: UPR system Certification 66 also governs this campus; it is collected under puerto-rico-mayag-ez (same URL) and not duplicated here. An earlier Sept 2023 campus circular on an AI academic-research plan exists (uprrp.edu/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/CARTA-CIRCULAR-...) but is superseded by Circular 8 and was not collected. No Computer Science department or Natural Sciences faculty AI policy found.
